actual: Broker has two filled trades, but qmt_strategy trade/cash/lot facts and runtime algo lifecycle did not advance. The daily run is terminal failed while its controller remains active with pending action.

events.note: Added same-second fill stable ordering, removed derived cumulative quantity from trade identity conflicts, and added restart recovery after child persistence precedes vn.py core persistence.

expected: Broker-authoritative order and trade snapshots are replayed idempotently through one settlement path that persists trade identity, updates child/order status, settles cash and lots, updates vn.py core state and terminalizes the algo when complete. Duplicate recovery is a no-op; conflicts fail loud; no broker order is resubmitted.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
reproduce_command: Seed a runtime child and broker FILLED order plus trade snapshot, invoke recover twice, and assert one trade fact, one cash/lot settlement, terminal child/algo and zero broker submission on both recovery passes.
